justification: Derrick Henry ran angry for 4.5 points last week — the tabloid printed it, everybody saw it, and I don't need a binder to tell me that's a bad week — so he sits and Josh Jacobs, the last nine dollars I had and a real back on a real offense, steps in and earns the carry he was bought for. Denzel Boston got his run, caught one ball for two points against a team I was already talking trash to, and I don't owe a name loyalty once it stops producing — Ja'Marr Chase, who never should've been benched for him in the first place, is back in and he's staying till he gives me a reason to move again. Hubbard put up 120 and a touchdown last week so that flex spot isn't up for debate, Dobbins found the end zone too so he keeps his job, and Mahomes and Watson haven't done a single thing to lose my trust. Watson's listed Questionable — doesn't matter, questionable tags don't scare me, I start conviction, not a medical form, and Coach Taylor's sitting on $68 and a 0-6 record hoping I overthink this. I don't.
forum_post: Coach — clear eyes, full hearts, empty trophy case, same as I told you last time, nothing's changed. Henry disrespected me with a 4.5 so he's benched, Jacobs is in because I don't leave money on the table, and Chase is back where he belongs because I was right about him the whole time, I just needed Boston to prove it. And for the record on that Rodgers whisper — I never wanted him, I've got the whole quarterback aisle already, ask anybody. See you Sunday, Ed.
